body.en: len(s) is a built-in function that gives the number of characters. Methods are called with a dot: s.lower(), s.upper(), s.title(), s.capitalize(), s.swapcase(). Test methods return True or False: isalpha(), isdigit(), isalnum(), islower(), isupper(), isspace(). Methods never change s; they return a new *string*.
body.kn: len(s) ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ. lower(), upper(), title(), capitalize(), swapcase() ಮೆಥಡ್‌ಗಳು ಹೊಸ ಸ್ಟ್ರಿಂಗ್ ಕೊಡುತ್ತವೆ. isalpha(), isdigit(), isalnum() ಮುಂತಾದವು True ಅಥವಾ False ಕೊಡುತ್ತವೆ.

title.en: Search, strip, replace, split and join

body.en: count(sub) counts occurrences. find(sub) gives the first index or -1; index(sub) is the same but raises ValueError if not found. startswith() and endswith() check the ends. *strip*(), lstrip(), rstrip() remove spaces. replace(old, new) replaces every occurrence. split(sep) breaks a string into a list; sep.join(seq) joins items with sep. partition(sep) gives a 3-tuple.
body.kn: count() ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಎಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. find() ಸಿಗದಿದ್ದರೆ -1; index() ಸಿಗದಿದ್ದರೆ ValueError. strip() ಖಾಲಿ ಜಾಗ ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. replace() ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. split() ಲಿಸ್ಟ್ ಆಗಿ ಒಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ; join() ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

tagline.en: Built-in functions and methods: len, upper, lower, title, capitalize, count, find, index, startswith, endswith, the is… tests, strip, replace, split, join and partition, with standard programs.

myth.en: After s = "hello" and s.upper(), printing s shows HELLO.

truth.en: s is still "hello". Write s = s.upper() (or print(s.upper())) to use the new string. upper() returns a new string because the original cannot be changed. If the result is not stored, it is lost at once.

say.en: String methods return new values; the original string never changes.
find() gives −1 when absent; index() raises ValueError.
split() gives a list; join() makes one string from a list of strings.
partition() always returns 3 parts in a tuple.
The is… tests (isalnum, isalpha, isdigit, isupper…) return True/False and give False for the empty string.
